Name: Tea Time
Author: jfujii
Description:
[b][u][font=Georgia][size=6]--TEA TIME--[/size][/font][/u][/b]
[size=3]Currently this mod adds 25 different types of tea to the game. The teas have been revamped to implement the vanilla tea leaf crop into crafting teas, making for a more seamless experience.[/size]

[u][size=4][i]The added tea types are:
[/i][/size][/u][size=3]Apple Tea
Apricot Tea
Simple Black Tea
Blueberry Tea
Earl Gray Tea
Matcha Green Tea
Herbal Tea
Honey Tea
Iced Tea [Both Sweetened and Unsweetened]
Initial Tea [For the memes <(^.^<)]
Jasmine Blossom Tea
Melon Tea
Milk Tea
Minty Tea
Peach Tea
Rose Petal Tea
Strawberry Tea
And three variant types of Sugar Tea

[u]NEW to Version 1.2
[/u]Sweetened Iced Tea
Strawberry Iced Tea
Iced Milk Tea
Iced Mint Tea


[b][u][size=4]Where to Get the Stuff:[/size]
[/u][/b]The main crop needed to brew these delica-teas is the vanilla Tea Bush crop. The mod also adds a Mint Leaf crop which is used for some teas. Both of these can be found at Pierre's Shop and grow during the Spring and Summer seasons. All tea recipes are bought from Gus at the Stardew Valley Pub and cost 100 G each.

[b][u][size=4]What to do with the Stuff:[/size]
[/u][/b]You could sell the mint leaves for 30 g each or straight up munch on them... but it's more fun to brew teas! Tea have a variety of uses. You can of course sell them for a pretty penny, but drinking them provides an array of benefits! They also make for good gifts to the townspeople of Stardew Valley![/size]

[b]Version Info:[/b]
[u][size=3]Mod Version 1.2 (CURRENT):[/size][/u]
[size=3]- Added four new Teas
﻿- Sweetened Iced Tea
﻿- Strawberry Iced Tea
﻿- Iced Milk Tea
﻿- Iced Mint Tea
- Removed Tea Plant from mod
- Incorporated new Tea Leaves item from vanilla game
- Lowered tea requirements so each cup of tea only requires 1 tea leaf to brew
- Re-balanced some tea selling values
- Made it compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.4
[/size]
[size=3][u]Mod Version 1.1:[/u]
- Added compatibility with most other JSON Asset mods (Please contact if more compatibility issues arise)
- Renamed several items
- Updated Mint and Tea plant sprites
[/size][size=3]- Slightly slowed down the speed bonus from "Sugar with Tea"
[/size]
[size=3][u]Mod Version 1.0:[/u]
- Works for Stardew Valley version 1.3
- Added Tea to the game!
- Confirmed works for Stardew Valley Multiplayer[/size]

[/u][/b][/size]JsonAssets https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720?tab=description
SpaceCore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348[/url]


[size=4][b][u][s]Known Mod Conflicts:[/s]
[/u][/b][/size][b][u]UPDATE: As of Version 1.1 of Tea Time there should not be any mod conflicts with any of the other popular JSON asset mods.[/u][/b]
[s]Currently all JsonAsset mods that share the same names for items as my mod will cause conflict. This will be resolved in the future as I will think of a renaming scheme for my teas and items.[/s]

As a friendly reminder, loading mods into a previously established game may cause problems with current items in the save's inventory and storage. To resolve these issues, it's generally safe to trash glitched items, and normally all new items gained through gameplay will be normal.

[/u][/b][/size][s]- Fix mod conflicts with other JSON asset mods[/s]
- Add more tea types
﻿- Add more iced tea
﻿- Add tea for each fruit type
- Add more tea-related items


[b][u][size=4]Installation:
[/size][/u][/b]1) Download the mod
2) Unzip/extract the folder
3) Drag the extracted folder [JA] TeaTime into your Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder
4) Check to make sure JsonAssets is downloaded and in the same Mods folder
5) Done!
